items.headline: Seized residential cruise ship Odyssey heads to Singapore after operator collapses
items.summary: Lender took over the live-aboard ship Odyssey, which left Cambodia for Singapore around 4 November after operator Villa Vie Residences suspended sailings citing fuel costs; a Singapore auction may follow.

items.headline: Modi speaks with Zelenskyy and Russia ahead of US-brokered peace talks
items.summary: PM Narendra Modi spoke with Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy and New Delhi also contacted Moscow, signalling willingness to support peace efforts as US-mediated talks began.

items.headline: UK coverage is unavailable in today's edition
items.summary: UK News desk could not be compiled: BBC, Sky News and the Guardian fallback were all unreachable from the publishing environment and no UK-domestic story met the sourcing standard.

items.headline: Russia, Ukraine and the US resume peace talks in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Negotiators met in Abu Dhabi for their first US-brokered trilateral round since February; Kyiv rules out ceding held land and Moscow objects to European involvement.

items.headline: COP31 climate summit opens in Antalya as world leaders gather
items.summary: The UN COP31 conference (9-20 November) is under way in Antalya, Turkey, with the Leaders' Summit on 11-12 November hosted by Erdogan; the US sends no delegation and big new targets are played down.

items.headline: Nvidia's board opens an independent probe into CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: A committee of independent Nvidia directors with outside counsel is investigating reports Huang was targeted by a foreign-intelligence effort; the board says no US national security or company secrets were compromised.

items.headline: Wall Street falls as a hot inflation report revives Fed rate-hike fears
items.summary: US stocks dropped 10 November after hot October inflation: S&P 500 -0.38% at 7,520.93, Nasdaq -0.74% at 25,065.88, Dow -0.3% at 52,231.89, with Nvidia off ~5.5%.

items.headline: US inflation runs hot in October, lifting December rate-hike odds
items.summary: CPI rose 0.4% in October and core prices 0.3% for a third straight month, both above forecasts; Fed's Waller said a half-point December hike should be considered.

items.headline: Treasury yields climb as traders brace for another Fed hike
items.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield pushed toward 5% (~4.98%) and the two-year rose ~0.13 point after the inflation data and Waller's remarks.

items.headline: Sabalenka opens her WTA Finals campaign with a win in Indian Wells
items.summary: World No. 2 Aryna Sabalenka beat Karolina Muchova in her opening round-robin match at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells; defending champion Rybakina withdrew and was replaced by Kostyuk.

items.headline: NASA's Swift observatory reenters the atmosphere after 22 years
items.summary: NASA confirmed its Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory reentered over North Sumatra on 4 November after a failed reboost and solar-driven orbital decay; it logged over 2,000 gamma-ray bursts.

items.headline: Europe's Hera probe resolves the Didymos asteroid pair for the first time
items.summary: ESA's Hera, following NASA's 2022 DART impact, returned a ~60km close-up that for the first time separates the 780m Didymos from its moon Dimorphos; detailed images come 25 November.

items.headline: BepiColombo begins its arrival at Mercury after an eight-year journey
items.summary: The ESA-JAXA BepiColombo mission began its Mercury arrival, with orbit insertion set for 21 November; its two orbiters separate around 9 December.

items.headline: Mars may still be volcanically active, an ESA orbiter hints
items.summary: ESA's ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter found localised hydrogen-chloride gas over Alba Mons plus fresh fissures, a possible signature of gas from magma at depth; no eruptions seen.

fun_fact.headline: The Sahara was green until about 5,000 years ago
fun_fact.body: Until around 5,000 years ago the Sahara was green: during the African Humid Period a strengthened West African monsoon turned much of today's desert into grassland with lakes and rivers, home to hippos and crocodiles; rock art still shows cattle herding and swimming. The return to desert was driven mainly by a wobble in Earth's orbit (precession).
fun_fact.source: Bristol University / The Conversation / Nature Scitable

puzzle.title: Knaves Among Us
puzzle.body: Knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. A says B and C are both knaves; B says A is a knight; C says B is a knave. Identify each.
puzzle.approach: Assume each is a knight, then a knave; keep the consistent assignment.
puzzle.answer: A is a knave, B is a knave, C is a knight.

word_puzzle.title: Sorting Hat
word_puzzle.body: Sort 16 words into 4 groups of 4: chess pieces, shades of green, citrus fruits, church roles. Traps: LIME, BISHOP.
word_puzzle.approach: Fill the non-overlapping groups first to place the trap words.
word_puzzle.answer: Chess: PAWN,BISHOP,KNIGHT,ROOK | Green: OLIVE,JADE,EMERALD,LIME | Citrus: LEMON,ORANGE,GRAPEFRUIT,TANGERINE | Clergy: DEACON,VICAR,CANON,CURATE
